QB.best_interpretable_result: No tested bundle achieved the restrained retention gate; do not add prior-share/vacated-opportunity features to QB from this experiment.

RB.best_interpretable_result: No tested bundle achieved the restrained retention gate; do not add prior-share/vacated-opportunity features to RB from this experiment.

interpretation.headline: Target-opportunity context is position-specific. The tested bundle produced stable multi-season gains for WR and TE, but not for QB or RB.
interpretation.wr_te_hypothesis: For pass catchers, prior share alone is modest; the useful signal emerges when prior target share is conditioned on target-season opening role and how much prior-year target opportunity has vacated the opening team.
interpretation.qb_rb_caution: Do not generalize the WR/TE result to QB or RB. Their tested variants failed the evidence gate and remain excluded.
interpretation.next_gate: Re-run WR and TE selected bundles against FFToday on the exact matched historical player-season-stat cohort. Rolling improvement versus persistence alone is insufficient for production promotion.
